page.title: CELINE Solar ROI Calculator
page.description: Estimate the return on investment for your photovoltaic system in Italy.
page.tagline: Estimate the return on investment for your photovoltaic system

step1.title: Select location
step1.hintAfter: on the map by clicking and dragging a rectangle.

step2.title: System parameters
step2.hint: Enter the key financial and technical parameters for your installation.

map.addressNotFound: Address not found. Try a more specific search.
map.dragHint: Drag to draw a rectangle on the roof
map.editDragHandle: Drag white handles to move vertices
map.editAddVertex: Click teal dots to add a vertex
map.editDeleteVertex: Double-click a handle to delete it

fields.installationCostHint: Total project cost (materials + labour). Typical range: €1,200–2,000/kWp for residential.
fields.batteryHint: If your total cost includes a battery, enter its capacity here. The estimated battery cost will be subtracted to isolate PV investment.
fields.estimateCostFromPanels: Estimate cost from number of panels
fields.panelInfo: Panel: {wattPeak} Wp, {area} m², {efficiency}% efficiency. Cost curve: Italian market 2025–2026 (pre-IVA, chiavi in mano).
fields.consumptionMeterEstimated: Estimated from your meter data: {value} kWh/year
fields.consumptionMeterPending: Will be estimated from your meter data once loaded.
fields.consumptionHint: Total electricity drawn from the grid per year. Check your utility bills.
fields.userTypeHint: Affects applicable incentive tariffs (RID/CER rates differ by user category).
fields.regimeHint: RID: earn revenue selling excess energy back to the grid. CER: share energy within a community for additional incentives.
fields.profileHintManual: Enter your average hourly consumption (kWh) for each hour of the day.
fields.profileHintMeter: Use smart meter data from a folder of daily JSON files.
fields.profileHintHeatPump: Shifts consumption to daytime (higher self-consumption, +5–15pp autoconsumo).
fields.profileHintDefault: Select the profile that best matches your consumption pattern.
fields.smartMeterUnit: select folder with daily JSON files
fields.meterDataLoaded: Loaded {days} days of meter data. Estimated consumption: {consumption} kWh/year
fields.meterDataHint: Select the folder containing daily JSON files (YYYY-MM-DD.json) from your smart meter (C2G/e-distribuzione format).
fields.noValidMeterData: No valid meter data found in the selected folder.
fields.heatPumpHint: Additional annual electricity for a heat pump. Typical: 2,500–4,500 kWh/year.
fields.primaryResidenceHint: Affects IRPEF deduction rate: 50% for primary residence, 36% for secondary (2026).
fields.autoEstimateKwp: Auto-estimate system size from rooftop polygon
fields.lidarHint: Uses the Trentino Solar LIDAR database to calculate kWp from your rooftop area (only works within the Trento province). For other areas, disable this and enter kWp manually.
fields.systemSizeHint: Rated peak power of the PV array. 1 kWp ≈ 4–6 m² of panels.
fields.panelTiltHint: Angle from horizontal. Optimal for Italy: 30–35°. Flat roof: 10–15°.
fields.equityFractionHint: Fraction of CAPEX financed with own funds (1.0 = fully self-funded, no loan).
fields.irpefHint: Italian IRPEF deduction on PV installation cost (residential, ≤20 kWp). Uncheck if you don't have access to this incentive.

errors.lidarFallback: If your location is outside Trentino, disable the LIDAR estimation above and enter the system size in kWp manually.
errors.panelRange: Number of panels must be between {min} and {max}.

results.cerSplitHint: 55% of the CER incentive is freely available to the producer (libero). 45% must be distributed to CER members (vincolato). Only the libero portion enters the cashflow above.
results.hoverMonth: Hover over a month for details
results.cashflowHover: Hover over the chart to see year-by-year figures
